rationale: Three grammar-exposed features must not silently vanish: (1) permits clause — sealed class emits directional parent-to-child edges to permitted subtypes with relationshipType=permits; subtypes must NOT appear in the sealed class's inheritance parents. (2) varargs method parameter (String... labels) appears in the parameter list typed as String[] per JVM erasure convention used by the ERROR-recovery path. (3) the sealed hierarchy still emits normal inheritance edges from subclasses.
